description: Branch R-FMT-2 Generated values, GUID and counter generation through ADOX (ADOX.Catalog and ADOX.Table over an open ADO connection, ActiveConnection and ParentCatalog set by reference). After CreateDatabase and close, ADO opens the file; ADOX table AX1 gets an Integer column ID whose provider property Autoincrement is set True (with its Properties listed), and AX2 gets an Integer ID and a GUID column G (adGUID, 72) whose provider properties are listed and whose Jet OLEDB:AutoGenerate is set True before Tables.Append; each call's HRESULT is the observation. DAO then reopens the file, inserts three rows into each table that exists (without G) and reads them with the fields' Type and Attributes. Asks which provider properties an ADOX GUID column offers, whether the append is admitted, and what the engine stores for G.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
